results.notes: Implemented headless, deterministic TypeScript contracts in src/types/contracts.ts covering Waves 1-5 of SPEC.md, along with unit tests in tests/T01_contracts.test.ts and stigmergic notes in agent_notes/T01.md. Verified with npm run typecheck and npx vitest run tests/T01_contracts.test.ts (8/8 passed).

Implemented bounded 2D TileMap (64x64 default) with terrain, ore deposits, O(1) entity occupancy lookup, atomic multi-tile footprint occupation, and fail-closed OutOfBoundsError / SimulationError handling. All 13 unit tests in tests/T02_tilemap.test.ts pass with zero TypeScript errors in T02 files (note: an unrelated parallel agent file src/core/recipeRegistry.ts had a transient type error during full-repo tsc).

Implemented headless deterministic fixed-timestep TickLoop (60 ticks/sec) with canonical phase ordering (power -> mining -> smelting_assembling -> inserters -> belts -> stats), drift-free scaled accumulator, pause/resume, and fail-closed SimulationError validation. Verified with npm run typecheck and vitest (9/9 passed).

Implemented EntityManager with deterministic monotonic IDs, full lifecycle (spawn, rotate, destroy), O(1) ID/position queries, deterministic ascending-ID type queries, multi-tile footprint occupancy handling, WorldState hydration, and fail-closed validation. Typecheck and all 8 unit tests pass.

Implemented deterministic, headless, fail-closed typed pub/sub EventBus in src/core/eventBus.ts supporting itemProduced, entityPlaced, entityRemoved, researchCompleted, and powerBrownout. All 8 unit tests in tests/T05_eventBus.test.ts pass with zero type errors in T05 files.

Implemented canonical item registry for all 21 ItemIds with stack sizes, categories, and fuel values (coal = 4000 kJ), deeply frozen and fail-closed with UnknownItemError. Verified zero type errors in T06 files and 5/5 passing tests in tests/T06_itemRegistry.test.ts.

Implemented RecipeRegistry (T07) with fail-closed ItemId validation against injected T06 ItemValidator or canonical ItemIds, atomic batch registration, deterministic lookup/query helpers (including smelting auto-selection and tech unlock checks), and 9 passing unit tests.

Implemented deterministic, headless, fail-closed slot-based inventory in src/core/inventory.ts with stacking, optional per-slot filters, and atomic all-or-nothing consumeIngredients (plus Inventory class wrapper). Verified with npm run typecheck and vitest (15/15 passing).

Implemented Mulberry32 seeded PRNG (mulberry32, createMulberry32), deterministic map generator (generateMap) guaranteeing starting iron_ore, copper_ore, coal, and stone patches near (32, 32) on buildable terrain, and createInitialWorldState helper. Verified with npm run typecheck and vitest (7/7 tests passing).

Implemented deterministic canonical JSON serialization (canonicalStringify, serializeWorldState, hashWorldState) and fail-closed WorldState deserialization (deserializeWorldState throwing DeserializationError). Zero type errors in T10 files (only unrelated errors in concurrent T04 test file during full tsc), and all 8 unit tests in tests/T10_serializer.test.ts pass.

Implemented two-lane conveyor belt with exact power-of-2 speed (0.03125) and spacing (0.25), strict backpressure blocking with zero item loss, deterministic left-before-right extraction helpers, and fail-closed validation. Typecheck and all 7 unit tests pass.

Implemented T17 power grid & graph partitioning (supplyRadius = 5 Chebyshev square, wireReach = 7 Euclidean distance, deterministic BFS connected components, producer/consumer/accumulator assignment, fail-closed pole validation) with 7 passing unit tests and clean typecheck.

Implemented Wooden (16-slot) and Iron (32-slot) storage chests in src/logistics/chest.ts backed by T08 inventory and T06 itemRegistry stack sizes, with full unit test coverage in tests/T19_chest.test.ts and stigmergic note in agent_notes/T19.md. Verified with npm run typecheck and npx vitest run tests/T19_chest.test.ts (9/9 passing).

Implemented deterministic, fail-closed TechTree research state machine covering automation, logistics, steel_processing, and solar_energy with prerequisite DAG validation, recipe gating, science pack conservation (accepted/rejected counts), and optional EventBus researchCompleted emission. Verified with npm run typecheck and vitest (8/8 tests passed).

Implemented src/logistics/beltNetwork.ts (auto-curved corners, sideloading merges at offset 0.5, downstream-first topological update order for seamless cross-tile item handoff, head-on collision blocking, and optional externalHandoff callback) along with 14 passing unit tests in tests/T12_beltNetwork.test.ts and stigmergic notes in agent_notes/T12.md. Zero TypeScript errors in T12 files (tsc reported one unrelated WIP error in parallel task src/logistics/inserter.ts).

Implemented 2-tile-wide 50/50 alternating splitter in src/logistics/splitter.ts with strict item conservation under single-lane and dual-lane backpressure, plus belt integration helper advanceSplitterToBelts. All 6 tests in tests/T13_splitter.test.ts pass and tsc --noEmit reports zero errors in T13 files (2 unrelated errors exist in peer wave-2 files inserter.ts and undergroundBelt.ts).

Implemented T14 underground belt (entry/exit pairing up to 4 gap tiles / distance 1..5, accurate transit delay matched to BELT_SPEED = 0.03125, per-lane tick spacing, strict zero-loss backpressure conservation, and fail-closed validation). All 12 unit tests in tests/T14_undergroundBelt.test.ts pass with zero TypeScript errors in T14 files (note: unrelated in-progress error in src/logistics/inserter.ts from another wave-2 task).

Implemented deterministic, headless, fail-closed inserter state machine (idle -> picking -> swinging -> dropping -> returning) with strict item conservation, backpressure halting, WorldState entity routing, and filter predicate hook for T16. Verified with npm run typecheck and vitest (8/8 passing).

Implemented T18 per-tick power satisfaction solver (computePowerSatisfaction, scaleMachineSpeed, solvePowerNetwork, solvePowerGrid, getEntityPowerSatisfaction, getEffectiveMachineSpeed, getGlobalPowerSatisfaction) with accumulator buffering, brownout event emission, and fail-closed validation. All 13 unit tests in tests/T18_powerSolver.test.ts pass with zero TypeScript errors in T18 files (note: repo-wide typecheck currently reports 1 unrelated error in parallel task src/logistics/inserter.ts:30).

Implemented T16 Filter Inserter (`src/logistics/filterInserter.ts`) reusing T15's inserter state machine with a strict whitelist of up to 3 canonical ItemIds, fail-closed empty-whitelist and validation semantics, full item conservation, and 9 passing unit tests in `tests/T16_filterInserter.test.ts`. Typecheck and tests pass.

Implemented finite ore deposit helpers in src/machines/resourceNode.ts (createResourceNode, mineOne, mineOneFromTile, mineOneAt, mineOneFromFootprint, isDepleted, getRemainingAmount, getRemainingRatio, assertValidResourceNode) with strict determinism, fail-closed validation, and clean tile.resource = null depletion. All 9 unit tests in tests/T21_resourceNode.test.ts pass with zero TypeScript errors in T21 files (note: unrelated in-progress Wave 3 files assemblerMk2.ts and researchLab.ts had typecheck errors during parallel execution).

Implemented T24 Stone Furnace (coal-fueled smelter auto-selecting smelting recipes from input) with strict item/fuel conservation, tech-gating support, backpressure halting, EventBus itemProduced emission, and fail-closed validation. All 7 unit tests in tests/T24_stoneFurnace.test.ts pass with zero TypeScript errors in T24 files.

Implemented Electric Furnace (T25): 180 kW smelter running at 2x Stone Furnace speed scaled by power satisfaction, with auto-recipe selection, tech-tree unlock gating, atomic ingredient consumption, output backpressure conservation, deterministic ascending EntityId ticking, and fail-closed validation. All 8 unit tests in tests/T25_electricFurnace.test.ts pass with zero TypeScript errors in T25 files.

Implemented Assembler Mk1 (75 kW, <=2 ingredients, speed 0.5) in src/machines/assemblerMk1.ts with unit tests in tests/T26_assemblerMk1.test.ts (8/8 passing) and stigmergic note in agent_notes/T26.md. Zero TypeScript errors in T26 files (note: unrelated in-progress type error in src/machines/researchLab.ts from parallel T30).

Implemented T27 Assembler Mk2 (150 kW, <=4 ingredients, 0.75 crafting speed) with strict determinism, fail-closed recipe/power validation, atomic ingredient consumption, output backpressure halts, EventBus itemProduced emission, and WorldState batch ticking. All 8 tests in tests/T27_assemblerMk2.test.ts pass with zero TypeScript errors in T27 files.

Implemented coal-fueled Boiler + Steam Engine power generation (900 kW per engine, 1800 kW thermal per boiler) with strict energy/fuel conservation, deterministic ascending EntityId ordering, fail-closed validation, and full powerGrid/powerSolver integration. All 9 unit tests in tests/T28_steamPower.test.ts pass with zero type errors in T28 files (unrelated in-progress Wave 3 files had tsc errors).

Implemented T29 solar power & 3,600-tick day/night clock in src/machines/solarPower.ts with 60 kW peak solar panels, piecewise-linear day/dusk/night/dawn solar curve (0.6 cycle average), accumulator charge/discharge/proportional balancing helpers, fail-closed validation, and full-cycle T17/T18 power grid integration tests (12/12 passing, 0 type errors in T29 files).

Implemented 60 kW research lab machine with power-scaled research progress, fail-closed science pack validation, strict item conservation via TechTree.contributeScience, EventBus researchCompleted emission, and deterministic multi-lab updates. Typecheck and 8 unit tests pass.

Implemented canonical smelting recipes (iron_plate, copper_plate, stone_brick, steel_plate) with atomic fail-closed registration via registerSmeltingRecipes, steel_processing tech gating on steel_plate, furnace auto-recipe compatibility, unit tests, and stigmergic note.

Implemented intermediate assembling recipes (iron_gear, copper_cable, electronic_circuit) with deep immutability, atomic RecipeRegistry registration, and T20 TechTree alignment (electronic_circuit requires automation). Verified with npm run typecheck and vitest (7/7 tests passing).

Implemented logistics crafting recipes (transport_belt, inserter, power_pole) with atomic fail-closed registration, TechTree (T20) alignment, frozen definitions, and 6 passing unit tests. Typecheck and vitest both pass.

Implemented red_science and green_science crafting recipes with deeply frozen definitions and atomic fail-closed registration via registerScienceRecipes(registry). Verified with npm run typecheck and vitest (7/7 tests passed).

Implemented StatsTracker (src/machines/statsTracker.ts) for deterministic cumulative and rolling 60-second (3,600-tick) items/min production and consumption tracking, with EventBus integration, WorldState sync/hydration, fail-closed validation, and canonical ALL_ITEM_IDS snapshot ordering. All 12 unit tests in tests/T35_statsTracker.test.ts pass and tsc --noEmit reports 0 errors in T35 files (pre-existing/concurrent errors exist in sibling Wave 3 files assemblerMk1.ts, assemblerMk2.ts, and researchLab.ts).

Implemented T22 Burner Mining Drill (src/machines/burnerDrill.ts), unit tests (tests/T22_burnerDrill.test.ts, 7/7 passing), and stigmergic note (agent_notes/T22.md). Zero TypeScript errors in T22 files (the only tsc errors observed during typecheck were in parallel sibling task tests/T23_electricDrill.test.ts).

Implemented 90 kW Electric Drill mining 1 ore per 45 ticks scaled by power satisfaction, with strict item/mass conservation under output backpressure, clean resource depletion, deterministic ascending EntityId batch ticking, and fail-closed validation. Typecheck and all 8 unit tests in tests/T23_electricDrill.test.ts pass.

Implemented procedural 16x16 pixel-art SpriteAtlas covering all 5 terrains, 4 ores, 21 items, 48 animated belt variants (3 shapes x 4 directions x 4 frames), all 19 entity types (with active/glowing variants for machines), and separate basic/filter inserter base and arm parts. Headless-safe with lazy HTMLCanvasElement caching in browsers and mock-context fallback in Node/Vitest. Typecheck and all 9 unit tests pass.

Implemented pure and stateful pan/zoom camera, world/screen/tile coordinate transforms, and inclusive tile/footprint viewport culling in src/render/camera.ts with fail-closed CameraError validation and 16 passing unit tests in tests/T37_camera.test.ts.

Implemented T43 build hotbar (1-9 hotkeys, slot selection/toggling, hit-testing, Canvas 2D renderer) and deterministic rolling-window Tick/FPS readout. Verified with npm run typecheck and npx vitest run tests/T43_hotbar.test.ts (7/7 passing).

Implemented T44 clicked entity inspector (src/ui/inspector.ts) with pure deterministic view-model extraction for all 19 EntityType variants (inventory, progress, fuel, power %, statusText, details), tile-based selection helpers, text/HTML formatters, and Canvas 2D panel renderer. Added unit tests in tests/T44_inspector.test.ts and stigmergic notes in agent_notes/T44.md. Verified with npm run typecheck and vitest (5/5 passed).

Implemented T45 live production sparkline chart (ProductionGraph, computeSparklinePoints, formatRatePerMinute, renderProductionGraph) tracking iron_plate, copper_plate, iron_gear, and red_science with tick-driven deterministic sampling, fail-closed validation, and headless-testable Canvas 2D rendering. Typecheck and all 7 unit tests in tests/T45_productionGraph.test.ts pass.

Implemented T38 visible terrain and ore-patch renderer with viewport culling via T37 camera, procedural 16x16 sprite drawing via T36 SpriteAtlas, integer pixel snapping to eliminate subpixel seams, ore depletion skipping and richness alpha modulation, optional grid overlay, and fail-closed validation. Typecheck and all 9 unit tests pass.

Implemented tick-synced animated belt, splitter, underground belt, and moving lane item rendering in src/render/beltLayer.ts with viewport culling, deterministic two-pass draw ordering, and seamless straight/curved lane interpolation. All 11 unit tests in tests/T39_beltLayer.test.ts pass and beltLayer.ts/T39_beltLayer.test.ts have zero TypeScript errors.

Implemented T40 entityLayer.ts with deterministic two-pass rendering (machines/structures then inserters), active/idle sprite selection and LED status indicators, tick-synced furnace glow, rotating inserter arms with held items, viewport culling, and fail-closed validation. All 12 unit tests in tests/T40_entityLayer.test.ts pass with zero TypeScript errors in T40 files.

Implemented T41 power overlay renderer with toggleable PowerOverlay controller, viewport-culled power wires (with catenary sag and network health coloring), Chebyshev coverage squares clamped to world bounds, and deterministic tick-pulsed unpowered/brownout/blackout warning icons. All 6 unit tests in tests/T41_powerOverlay.test.ts pass and T41 files have zero TypeScript errors.

Implemented T42 ghost placement preview (evaluateGhostPlacement, evaluateGhostAtScreenPos, renderGhostPreview, GhostPreviewController) with per-tile footprint validation (bounds, water, occupancy, drill ore requirements), power-pole supply radius overlay, translucent SpriteAtlas rendering, directional arrows, viewport culling, and fail-closed error handling. All 16 unit tests pass and T42 files have zero TypeScript errors. (Note: unrelated peer wave-4 files in src/render/ currently have pre-existing typecheck errors from tileToScreen/worldToScreen argument order.)

Implemented 160x160 corner minimap renderer (src/render/minimap.ts) with pure geometry/color helpers (computeMinimapRect, computeCameraViewportBox, isPointInMinimap, minimapPointToWorld, getTileMinimapColor, renderMinimap), a Minimap class wrapper, structural MinimapCanvasContext interface, row-level run-length batching, and fail-closed MinimapError validation. All 10 unit tests in tests/T46_minimap.test.ts pass with zero TypeScript errors in T46 files (note: unrelated concurrent Wave 4 files beltLayer.ts, entityLayer.ts, ghostPreview.ts, powerOverlay.ts, and T41_powerOverlay.test.ts currently have pre-existing typecheck errors).
